value: Pack net seed 1 (packnet40k-s1 r1 @tsl1) one turn deep on the generated-enemies bench's eight costliest or edge rows (675 elite starts x 16 seeds) against the 10-29 net @tsl1 on the same starts: HP lost per elite fight, pack net minus 10-29, parent +0.62 (0.16); AttackLoss-Damage +3.22 (0.40), OppCard-PlainDamage +2.15 (0.28), OppCard-Damage +1.92 (0.29), TurnStart-Weak +1.69, TurnEnd-Weak +1.63, OppCard-Vulnerable +11.67 (0.75; wins -0.304, the 10-29 net's +0.153 edge lost; Lagavulin +18.61); better on OppCard-Weak -2.24 (0.51) and AttackLoss-Weak -2.06 (0.40, cut 0.48). Breadth of official and Act 1 content buys no zero-shot transfer to generated mechanics and costs it on five of seven costly rows: the pack net is not a goal-1 base for generated packs. Single seed; whether the cause is the recipe or the pack's few powers is read by 0779 (all-content twin) and 0780 (seed 101). Attribution (0779): the all-content twin (no packs, same recipe, seed 1) @tsl1 on the same rows, win gain against the 10-29 net: AttackLoss-Damage -0.029 (0.006), OppCard-Weak -0.020, AttackLoss-Weak +0.042, OppCard-PlainDamage -0.043, OppCard-Damage -0.047, TurnStart-Weak -0.027, TurnEnd-Weak -0.021, OppCard-Vulnerable -0.267 (0.014); parent -0.005: the recipe (40k games, one round), not the pack, loses the bench; the pack adds -0.025 to -0.039 on AttackLoss-Damage and the OppCard damage rows.
